title: arabic-latex-templates: A collection of 91 Arabic/RTL LaTeX templates
description: A collection of 91 Arabic/RTL LaTeX templates organized into 10 categories: Academic & Research, Business & Legal, Project Management, Education & Personal, Presentations, Letters & Correspondence, Finance & Accounting, Marketing & Communications, Personal & Life, and Technical & Engineering. All templates use XeLaTeX with the Amiri font and polyglossia/bidi for full right-to-left Arabic typesetting.
